protocol.whiteboard_rule: 모든 서브에이전트는 작업 시작 전 .claude/whiteboard.json 을 읽고, 종료 전 반드시 .claude/wb/<ROLE>.json 에 자신의 상태(Status: Waiting|In Progress|Done)와 산출물 경로를 기록한다. 규칙을 어기고 종료 금지.
protocol.parallel_write_note: JSON 손상 방지: 병렬 에이전트는 공유 whiteboard.json 을 직접 쓰지 않고 각자 .claude/wb/<ROLE>.json 에 기록. PM 이 단일 writer 로 병합해 whiteboard.json 갱신.
protocol.unity_constraint: Unity batchmode 는 단일 배타 자원 → 빌드/검증(QA)만 직렬. 코드/에셋/사운드 제작은 병렬.

roles.PM: 전체 일정 관리 및 task.json 발행, whiteboard 병합, commit/close
roles.Director: 핵심 기획 및 아트/사운드 최종 승인 (feel/tone)
roles.Art: 에셋 생성 + 파이프라인 가이드 + 목업 검토
roles.QA: 버그 리포트 + 프로그램 검증 (Unity 빌드/하니스 - 단일 배타)
roles.AIDesigner: FSM/BT 등 AI 로직 설계 + 경로탐색 안전 제약

wave.lane_contract: STRICT file isolation. Lane A owns NEW SleepPoseDriver.cs only (self-attach driver pattern like FlickerLight/PawnFacing; reads PawnNeeds/IsSleeping, sets ONLY the child SpriteRenderer.color alpha/tint to dim a sleeping pawn — MUST NOT touch flipX (PawnFacing owns), localPosition Y (PawnSpriteBob owns), or root transform). Lane B owns the UI button files GuiControlBar.cs + ArchitectMenu.cs + ResearchUI.cs only (route their button onClick through the EXISTING AudioBank.PlaySelect(); MUST NOT edit AudioBank.cs). Lane C owns a NEW PlayMode/EditMode test file under the existing test asmdef only (food chain assertions; touches NO runtime .cs). Lane D solely owns AudioBank.cs (add rainLoop clip slot + Play/StopRain on a dedicated looping AudioSource) AND NEW RainSoundDriver.cs (polls WeatherController.Instance.Current, starts loop on Storm, stops on Clear) — WeatherController.cs is NOT edited. No SceneSetup*.cs / SceneSetup.Pawn.cs / SceneSetup.Game.Entities.cs touched by any lane. No two lanes touch the same file. Runtime non-fight: A=child renderer COLOR only (PawnFacing=flipX, PawnSpriteBob=childY — three distinct properties, no collision); B touches UI .cs only and calls existing PlaySelect (no AudioBank edit); D solely owns AudioBank.cs this wave (B does NOT edit it).
subtasks: Lane A (game-programmer, M3 sleep-pose #12): NEW Assets/Scripts/SleepPoseDriver.cs ONLY. Self-attaching via [RuntimeInitializeOnLoadMethod(AfterSceneLoad)] driver that sweeps PawnMovement (or pawn-root) instances and ensures one SleepPoseDriver each (copy the FlickerLight.cs / PawnFacing.cs driver+EnsureOn pattern). Per-frame: read whether the pawn IsSleeping (locate the sleep flag the same way PawnInfoPanel/PawnNeeds reads it; if sleeping detection API is unclear, FLAG for QA rather than guessing). When sleeping, dim the child body SpriteRenderer.color (e.g. multiply toward a darker/desaturated tint, ~0.6 value) so a sleeping pawn is visually distinct from a standing one; restore full color when awake. MUST NOT touch child SpriteRenderer.flipX (PawnFacing owns it), child localPosition Y (PawnSpriteBob owns it), or the root transform. Do NOT edit SceneSetup*, PawnFacing, PawnSpriteBob, PawnMovement. Wiki acceptance #12: a sleeping pawn is visually distinct (dimmed) from a standing one.

Lane B (game-programmer, M2 UI-click #5): GuiControlBar.cs + ArchitectMenu.cs + ResearchUI.cs ONLY. Route every button's onClick through the EXISTING AudioBank.PlaySelect() (the same call pawn-select already uses) so clicking any UI button plays the soft blip. Resolve the AudioBank instance gracefully (find-once/cache like ClickSelector pattern; null no-op if absent). MUST NOT edit AudioBank.cs (PlaySelect already exists) or any entity/SceneSetup file. Wiki acceptance #5: clicking any UI button plays the blip.

Lane C (game-build-engineer, M5 verify #25 food-chain): NEW test file under the existing PlayMode/EditMode test asmdef ONLY (same asmdef as V4CombatChainTest.cs; add a new V5_FoodChain test .cs, do NOT edit existing test files or any runtime .cs). Assert the full food chain as ONE binary PASS: crop plant -> ripen (force/advance growth) -> harvest -> cook at stove -> pawn eats -> the pawn's food/hunger need rises. Use the existing TestRunner harness conventions (same bootstrap pattern V4CombatChainTest used: ResearchManager bootstrap, manual component add where needed). If a runtime API needed to drive plant/ripen/cook/eat is missing, FLAG it for QA rather than editing runtime. Wiki acceptance #25: a single gated test asserts the full food chain raises a pawn's food need.

Lane D (game-sound-designer, M2 rain loop #9): Assets/Scripts/AudioBank.cs AND NEW Assets/Scripts/RainSoundDriver.cs ONLY (both solely owned by this lane; WeatherController.cs is NOT edited). In AudioBank.cs add a rainLoop AudioClip slot + a dedicated looping AudioSource + PlayRain()/StopRain() (graceful null no-op; generate a rain.wav + .meta following the prior _gen_m2_sfx.py / ForceUpdate meta pattern — soft continuous filtered-noise rain bed, loopable). In NEW RainSoundDriver.cs (self-attach via [RuntimeInitializeOnLoadMethod] like FlickerLight) poll WeatherController.Instance.Current: on WeatherKind.Storm call AudioBank.PlayRain(), on Clear call StopRain(). MUST NOT edit WeatherController.cs or any other entity/director/SceneSetup file. NOTE scene-side SerializeField wiring of rainLoop on the AudioBank GameObject is required -> FLAG for QA (same pattern as prior sfxBuild/alert/ambient/mine wiring). Wiki acceptance #9: a storm plays a rain loop; clear weather is silent of rain.
